text: K3 quotes Howard Carter's account of opening Tutankhamun's tomb, so his book is a natural running key: the text written under the message, one letter per place, starting anywhere.
Each known place needs one key letter. Drawn for one way of using the table at the start that matches most: 8 of 24.
Every start, forwards and backwards, under 24 ways of using the table: 13,675,872 trials, none within two of the 24.
